description:
USB rechargeable electric gas lighter with a 360° flexible neck is the safer, cleaner way to light a gas stove, candle jars, diya wicks, incense, or a BBQ—without struggling with matchsticks or disposable lighters. The flameless plasma arc creates a concentrated spark at the tip, so you can reach deep burners and tight corners while keeping fingers farther from heat. Because it’s windproof, it keeps working on balconies, patios, and camping trips where a normal flame keeps dying out.

A built-in safety lock helps prevent accidental clicks in drawers or bags, and the LED battery indicator shows when it’s time to recharge. Charge it by USB, bend the neck to the angle you need, and get quick ignition for everyday cooking, festive décor, and outdoor grilling—without buying gas refills again and again.
